NO. 1503/2024 IN CRIME NO.78/2024 FOR THE ALLEGED OFFENCES U/S. 376(2) (N) OF THE IPC AND SECTION 5(J), 5(L) AND 6 OF THE POSCO ACT, 2012, REGISTERED BY VYALIKAVAL POLICE STATION, BENGALURU, NOW PENDING ON THE FILE HONBLE FTSC-IV ADDL. DISTRICT AND SESSIONS JUDGE, BENGALURU.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S VISHWAJITH SHETTY  ORAL ORDER
Learned counsel for the petitioner, after arguing the matter for some time, submits that the petitioner is in custody from 21.06.2024.
The prosecution has already examined the material chargesheet witnesses before the trial court and only official witnesses are required to be examined now.
He further submits that considering the aforesaid aspects of the matter, the trial court may be directed to expedite the trial and dispose of the case on merits.

Learned HCGP fairly does not oppose the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioner and further submits that efforts shall be made before the trial court to complete the trial at the earliest.
3. Submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned HCGP is placed on record.

4. The petition is dismissed with a request to the trial court to dispose of the case on merits as expeditiously as possible but not later than a period of six months from the date of receipt of certified copy of the order.

Sd/-
(S VISHWAJITH SHETTY) JUDGE HDK Bharath vs State By on 10 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59036697/
